<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to choose correct description. Let's analyze each.

A: Data construction uses only training sets of GSM8k and MATH as seed datasets, then Evol-Instruct augment. The article description: They used GSM8k and MATH, regenerated 15k answers with step-by-step format, filtered correct ones, used for SFT; also sampled 1.5k open-domain conversations. So they didn't just use GSM8k and MATH as seed; they also used open-domain conversations. So A is not fully correct.

B: Step 2-3 can complete training without relying on external models. Step 2: training Instruction Reward Model (IRM) and Process-supervised Reward Model (PRM). The article says they rely on ChatGPT and Wizard-E to generate instructions and to label steps. So external models are used. So B is incorrect.

C: WizardMath models of all sizes have achieved mathematical abilities that exceed those of partially identical/larger closed source models. From results: WizardMath 70B outperforms GPT-3.5? It says 70B slightly outperforms some closed-source like ChatGPT, Claude Instant-1, PaLM 2. WizardMath 13B outperforms PaLM 1 540B, etc. So yes, WizardMath models of all sizes exceed those of partially identical/larger closed source models. Track: 13B vs GPT-3.5 8B? They say surpasses GPT-3.5 (8B is larger closed source)? Actually GPT-3.5 is about 6B? GPT-3.5 maybe similar size. They say 13B surpasses GPT-3.5 (size unknown). But 7B surpasses many open-source but not those closed source. So claim "exceed those of partially identical/larger closed source models" maybe true: 13B beats larger closed source 540B? no they say 13B surpasses PaLM 1 540B (39? Actually 13B > 540B? Not larger). But they say "compared to the closed-source models" 13B surpasses 540B? That seems false. But they say "WizardMath 70B slightly outperforms some closed-source LLMs on GSM8k, including ChatGPT, Claude Instant-1, and PaLM 2." So it exceeds closed-source. 13B? does it exceed closed? maybe yes? They say 13B surpasses PaLM 1 540B in GSM8k. So 13B size is less but beats larger. So C could be correct.

Check D: Article uses different methods to ensure no harmful content? The article mentions they are working with legal team to review and release code; mention ethical impact. But not explicitly describing methods to prevent harmful content. So D probably not correct.

Thus answer C.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\boxed{C}
